alignment: NFC; whole-page code-point Levenshtein, active truth lines joined by spaces; pass 1; diagonal/deletion/insertion ties; newline edits excluded; includes question/figure/table/solution

confidence.lineMatching: Pass 1, active predicted lines; NFC trimmed exact match to any active truth line on the same page; unmatched = wrong; failed pages excluded
confidence.formula: High = empirical correct-line conf >= 0.85, capped at 0.999999; low = empirical wrong-line conf < 0.85. Per changed line draw silent with P = wrongHighLines/wrongLines for its engine; changed characters use wrongHigh (silent) or wrongLow. Unchanged characters use correctHigh. Deletion transfers confidence to nearest surviving character (next, else previous). conf = min(charConf), empty text conf = 0. NFC code-point Levenshtein locates changed characters. Confidence RNG = xorshift32(seed XOR 0x434f4e46), independent of text noise.
